svg.text: AERIS-10 — PA heat-spreader temperature map, 2-D finite differences — DSN-CALC-01 (A-continuous-bias)
Date 2026-10-09 · PROPOSED DESIGN calculation · plate 300×300×10 Al k=200 W/mK, 60×60 cells, 16 × 5×5 mm sources at the PA board centres, fin strips h_eff 288 W/m²K, elsewhere 5 W/m²K
Conduction through the PA board and TIM (≈ 2 °C/W → +8 °C at the die base in case B) is NOT included in the map; see THERMAL_AND_PA_SUPPLY.md
